Гадодиамид C16H26GdN5O8 = 573.7. CAS — 131410-48-5 (anhydrous gadodiamide); 122795- 43-1 (gadodiamide hydrate). ATC — V08CA03. ATC Vet — QV08CA03. Pharmacopoeias. In US. USP 31 (Gadodiamide). A white, odourless, powder. Freely sol- uble in water and in methyl alcohol; soluble in alcohol; slightly soluble in acetone and in chloroform. Store in airtight containers. Adverse Effects and Precautions As for Gadopentetic Acid, below. Effects on the pancreas. Acute pancreatitis developed in a patient shortly after injection of gadodiamide for hepatic imag- ing.1 Another patient2 developed both acute pancreatitis and acute renal failure after use of gadodiamide for angiography. 1. Terzi C, Sökmen S. Acute pancreatitis induced by magnetic-res- onance-imaging contrast agent. Lancet 1999; 354: 1789–90. Correction. ibid. 2000; 355: 660. 2. Schenker MP, et al. Gadolinium arteriography complicated by acute pancreatitis and acute renal failure. J Vasc Interv Radiol 2001; 12: 393. Interference with diagnostic tests. Gadodiamide may inter- fere with colorimetric methods for measuring serum calcium concentrations, resulting in falsely low measurements.
